title: Context and cancellation
summary: Keep cancellation ownership explicit in concurrent Go work.

spec.practice: Make cancellation ownership explicit at every concurrent boundary.
appliesWhen: Work starts goroutines or accepts context.Context.
doesNotApplyWhen: The code is purely synchronous and has no cancellable operation.
guidance: Pass context explicitly and make the owner responsible for cancellation.
verification: Inspect shutdown and cancellation paths when they are material to the change.
